UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents a user's public profile and core information within the HarmonyAI dating application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserProfile entity. This is typically the Firebase Authentication UID.

profilePhotoUrl.description: URL to the user's profile photo stored in Firebase Storage.

bio.description: A short biographical description provided by the user.

gender.description: The user's gender identity (e.g., 'male', 'female', 'non-binary', 'prefer not to say').

dateOfBirth.description: The user's date of birth, used for age calculation.

location.description: The user's general location (e.g., city, state) for local matching.

isVerified.description: Indicates if the user's identity has been successfully verified. (Derived from verificationStatus).

verificationStatus.description: The current status of the user's identity verification process. (enum: 'not_verified', 'pending', 'verified', 'rejected').

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the user profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the user profile was last updated.

UserPersonality.title: UserPersonality
UserPersonality.description: Stores the personality and communication style analysis results for a user, derived from the AI interview feature.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserPersonality entity.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile this personality analysis belongs to. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:1 UserPersonality)

personalityType.description: AI-derived primary personality type or category (e.g., 'Extrovert', 'Analyst').

communicationStyle.description: AI-derived description of the user's communication style (e.g., 'Direct', 'Empathetic').

keyTraits.description: An array of key personality traits identified by the AI.

analysisDetails.description: A flexible field to store more detailed or raw JSON output from the AI personality analysis.

lastAnalysisDate.description: Timestamp of the most recent AI personality analysis.

Match.title: Match
Match.description: Represents a potential or confirmed match between two users, based on AI analysis and user interaction.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Match entity.

user1Id.description: Reference to the UserProfile of the first participant in the match. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N Match)

user2Id.description: Reference to the UserProfile of the second participant in the match. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N Match)

matchScore.description: A numerical score indicating the compatibility between user1 and user2, typically 0-100.

status.description: The status of the match from user1's perspective towards user2. (enum: 'pending', 'accepted', 'rejected', 'blocked').

user1ActionedAt.description: Timestamp when user1 last interacted with this match (e.g., liked or rejected).

user2ActionedAt.description: Timestamp when user2 last interacted with this match (e.g., liked or rejected).

isMutual.description: Indicates if both users have mutually accepted each other, leading to an active conversation possibility.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this match record was initially created or suggested.

Conversation.title: Conversation
Conversation.description: Represents a one-on-one chat conversation between two matched users.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Conversation entity.

participantIds.description: An array containing the IDs of the two UserProfiles participating in this conversation. (Relationship: UserProfile N:N Conversation)

lastMessageContent.description: The content of the most recent message in the conversation (denormalized for quick display in UI).

lastMessageSenderId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who sent the last message (denormalized for quick display). (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N Conversation)

lastMessageSentAt.description: Timestamp when the last message in the conversation was sent (denormalized).

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the conversation was initiated.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the conversation was last updated (e.g., a new message was sent).

Message.title: Message
Message.description: Represents a single message sent within a conversation.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Message entity.

conversationId.description: Reference to the Conversation this message belongs to. (Relationship: Conversation 1:N Message)

senderId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who sent this message. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N Message)

content.description: The actual text content of the message.

sentAt.description: Timestamp when the message was sent.

readBy.description: An array of UserProfile IDs who have read this message. (Relationship: UserProfile N:N Message)

VerificationRequest.title: VerificationRequest
VerificationRequest.description: Stores details about a user's identity verification submission, including references to uploaded documents.

id.description: Unique identifier for the VerificationRequest entity.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile for whom this verification request was submitted. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N VerificationRequest)

idCardFrontUrl.description: URL to the front side of the user's identification card, stored in Firebase Storage.

idCardBackUrl.description: URL to the back side of the user's identification card, stored in Firebase Storage (optional, depending on ID type).

selfieUrl.description: URL to the user's selfie photo, stored in Firebase Storage, for liveness/identity check.

status.description: The current status of the verification request. (enum: 'pending', 'approved', 'rejected').

submittedAt.description: Timestamp when the verification request was submitted.

reviewedAt.description: Timestamp when the verification request was reviewed (optional).

reviewerId.description: Reference to the admin or moderator UserProfile who reviewed this request (if applicable). (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N VerificationRequest)

rejectionReason.description: A textual explanation if the verification request was rejected (optional).

definition.description: Stores core user profile data, including public information and private verification status. Document ID is the Firebase Auth UID. Authorization: Owner (request.auth.uid == userId) has R/W. Other authenticated users can read public fields for matching and display.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique Firebase Authentication UID of the user.

definition.description: Stores AI-derived personality and communication style analysis results for a specific user (1:1 relationship with UserProfile). The document ID 'personality_data' is a fixed string. Authorization: Only the owner (request.auth.uid == userId) has R/W access. Includes denormalized 'userId' for robust rules and queries.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique Firebase Authentication UID of the user whose personality data is stored.

definition.description: Stores details about a user's identity verification submission. Authorization: Only the owner (request.auth.uid == userId) has R/W. Future admin roles may have read/update access. Includes denormalized 'userId' for robust rules and queries.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique Firebase Authentication UID of the user submitting the verification request.

params.name: requestId
params.description: The unique identifier for the specific verification request.

definition.description: Represents a potential or confirmed match between two users. Stored in a top-level collection for efficient querying by either participant. Authorization: Accessible if request.auth.uid matches either 'user1Id' or 'user2Id'. Includes denormalized 'user1Id' and 'user2Id' fields for authorization independence.

params.name: matchId
params.description: The unique identifier for the match.

definition.description: Represents a one-on-one chat conversation between two matched users. Stored in a top-level collection for efficient querying of a user's conversations. Authorization: Accessible if request.auth.uid is present in the 'participantIds' array. Includes denormalized 'participantIds' for authorization independence.

params.name: conversationId
params.description: The unique identifier for the conversation.

definition.description: Represents a single message sent within a conversation. Authorization: Accessible if request.auth.uid is present in the denormalized 'participantIds' array. The 'participantIds' are copied from the parent conversation to ensure authorization independence and prevent get() calls in rules.

params.name: conversationId
params.description: The unique identifier of the parent conversation.

params.name: messageId
params.description: The unique identifier for the message.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore data structure for HarmonyAI prioritizes security, scalability, and debuggability by adhering to the core design principles. 

**Authorization Independence (CRITICAL):**
This design ensures Authorization Independence primarily through denormalization. For documents in subcollections like `messages`, critical authorization data (e.g., `participantIds`) from the parent `conversation` document is copied directly into each `message` document. This eliminates the need for expensive and complex `get()` calls to parent documents within security rules, allowing atomic operations and simplifying rule evaluation. For top-level collaborative collections like `matches` and `conversations`, all necessary participant IDs (`user1Id`, `user2Id`, `participantIds`) are stored directly within each document, enabling rules to evaluate access based solely on the document's own data. User-specific private data (profiles, personality, verification requests) are structured hierarchically under `/user_profiles/{userId}/...`, making ownership explicit and rule evaluation straightforward based on the path wildcard `{userId}` matching `request.auth.uid`.

**QAPs (Rules are not Filters):**
The structure supports Query-Able Paths (QAPs) by applying structural segregation and consistent access modeling:
1.  **User Profiles:** `/user_profiles/{userId}` allows direct reads for the owner (`request.auth.uid == userId`) and authenticated reads for public profile information by others. `list` operations for general browsing can be performed on `/user_profiles`, with rules restricting fields or ensuring only public profiles are visible.
2.  **User Personality:** Stored at `/user_profiles/{userId}/personality/personality_data`. Access is strictly limited to the owner, facilitating a direct `get` by authenticated users for their own personality data, and preventing unauthorized `list` access.
3.  **User Verification Requests:** Stored at `/user_profiles/{userId}/verification_requests/{requestId}`. Access is restricted to the owner, allowing them to `list` and manage their own verification requests. Future admin roles could be granted `list` access to `/user_profiles/{userId}/verification_requests` to review requests, with rules ensuring they can only read and update specific status fields.
4.  **Matches:** `/matches/{matchId}` is a top-level collection containing `user1Id` and `user2Id`. This enables QAPs for finding all matches for a user by querying `where('user1Id', '==', request.auth.uid)` or `where('user2Id', '==', request.auth.uid)`. Rules will then ensure that `request.auth.uid` is either `user1Id` or `user2Id` for any `get`, `update`, or `delete` operation on a specific `matchId`.
5.  **Conversations:** `/conversations/{conversationId}` is a top-level collection with a `participantIds` array. This supports efficient QAPs using `where('participantIds', 'array-contains', request.auth.uid)` to retrieve all conversations for the authenticated user.
6.  **Messages:** `/conversations/{conversationId}/messages/{messageId}`. Each `Message` document includes the denormalized `participantIds`. This allows users to `list` messages within a specific conversation (`/conversations/{conversationId}/messages`) while the security rules on the `message` document itself can verify `request.auth.uid in resource.data.participantIds` without needing to check the parent `conversation` document.

**Structural Segregation:**
Each collection or subcollection generally holds documents with a homogeneous security posture. For example, `user_profiles` holds publicly viewable (with some private fields) profiles, `matches` holds records accessible by two specific users, and `conversations` documents are accessible by their participants. This reduces rule complexity by making access patterns predictable per collection.

**Access Modeling:**
*   **Private User Data:** `UserProfile`, `UserPersonality`, and `VerificationRequest` are all structured using hierarchical, path-based ownership under `/user_profiles/{userId}/...`, ensuring that `request.auth.uid` must match the `{userId}` wildcard for primary access.
*   **Collaborative Data:** `Match` and `Conversation` entities use explicit ID fields (`user1Id`, `user2Id`, `participantIds`) for membership-based authorization, enabling flexible querying and secure access for all involved parties.

This architecture provides a robust foundation for HarmonyAI's security rules, ensuring data integrity and efficient data access while minimizing complexity.
